arithmetic: exact rational arithmetic over canonical decimal coordinate/spacing values; sqrt bounds use integer arithmetic at 1e-12 m; pi upper bound 355/113
proof_scope: all translations and orientations in the declared Euclidean 2-D lattice family, with lattice centers in the represented valid polygonal usable geometry; not arbitrary point placement
proof_outline: Centered fundamental cells of accepted lattice points are disjoint up to boundaries, each has area at least cell_area_lower_bound, and each lies in the radius-R parallel body of conv(U). Steiner's formula bounds that body's area by A_hull + P_hull*R + pi*R^2. All irrational terms are conservatively enclosed with rational bounds. Therefore N <= floor(area_upper/cell_area_lower).
